title: A blood pressure correction opened on a row with no pair ids sends replace with seenIds []
evidence: Was: decided: leave. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/BloodPressureSheet.swift Save sends seen: correcting?.pairIds ?? []. Read without running (PR 1305): ios/engine/blood-pressure.ts:62 refuses a replace whose seenIds differ from the day's active ids (sameIds, :83-86, false on a length difference) with reason record-changed and writes nothing; with no active half on the day, sameIds([], []) is true and a fresh pair is appended (:68-79), replacing nothing. So an empty-ids replace never replaces a wrong row or every row; the worst case is the record-changed message
